{{Top|leg}}
A '''Friendly Hutt''' was an old [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] tactic which involved a battle [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] feigning ignorance of a hidden enemy in order to force them to reveal their position.

==History==
When the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] discovered a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] fleet at the [[Black Bantha Nebula/Legends|Black Bantha Nebula]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] wondered if the enemy fleet was trying to pull a Friendly Hutt.
